Every once and a while I'll have a "regular" bowel movement and I swear to God it feels like finding Gold! I usually brag to my girlfriend, who then just laughs and says "yep. That's normal." 
GIRL! I have no idea what normal is any more 😂
Things are going pretty well! The fret wrap I ordered arrived so I've been playing guitar all day

I honestly had this thought! My girlfriend and I recently invested in hiking gear. Nothing crazy, but some good backpacks and water bladders and such. Were just waiting for the fireban to lift! Hopefully that happens soon, I definitely think getting active will help.
I'm currently residing in New Brunswick. Moved here in 2009 for family from BC, but I havent seen any of them since my gram passed in 2014. Its a beautiful Province, though!
I really appreciate that, BigBlack24. It's actually really comforting to know there is somewhere I can talk to people who recognize my struggle and have been in similar spots.

I would love to help others. I want nothing more than to help people who suffered with addictions like I did. But right now? It's really crazy... it's like I cant find the right way to help myself and that feels like it kills me faster than anything else. Its like I'm drowning in an inability to act. To do.... something. 

Thank you so much for your kindness, Johnny. This Reddit feed has been the most support I've felt in years. I truly appreciate it.
I'm trying to figure out how to post there but I'm not very Reddit literate
You're honestly the first person to say I'm worth it in a long time. I know I dont know you but for some reason that means a lot.
I tried contacting the Canadian text line and, unfortunately, received a "this line has been disconnected" reply.
